demo-manali-trip-2026.address: Log Huts Area, Old Manali Road, Manali, HP 175131

demo-manali-trip-2026.theme: Doorstep Departure, Scenic Train & Old Manali Arrival

weatherForecast.summary: Crisp, sunny autumn mountain weather.

items.title: Doorstep Cab Pick-up from Moradabad Home
items.description: Pre-scheduled electric taxi arrives at home to transfer all 4 travellers with baggage to Moradabad Railway Station.

items.title: Board Vande Bharat Express (Train 22435)
items.description: Comfortable air-conditioned express train journey with onboard breakfast and scenic foothills views.

items.title: Scenic Mountain Transfer & Hotel Check-in
items.description: Private connecting tempo cab reaches Manali via panoramic valley highway. Check into Pineview Eco Retreat.

items.title: Old Manali Heritage Walk & Cafe Welcome Dinner
items.description: Stroll across apple orchards and wooden bridges, enjoying wood-fired trout pizza and spiced apple tea at Cafe 1947.

weatherAlternative.title: Artisanal Himalayan Hearth Indoor Bistro
weatherAlternative.description: Cozy indoor dining sanctuary featuring wood-fired dining, live acoustic folk music, and warm herbal teas.
weatherAlternative.indoorReason: Shielded from outdoor rain & cold winds.

demo-manali-trip-2026.theme: Solang Valley Nature Hike, Authentic Dham & Cultural Heritage

weatherForecast.summary: Clear skies and gentle valley breeze.

items.title: Solang Valley Panoramic Trek & Pine Forest Walk
items.description: Guided morning nature trek along crystal clear streams and mountain vantage points with views of snow-capped peaks.

weatherAlternative.title: Himalayan Art, Culture & Heritage Museum
weatherAlternative.description: State-of-the-art interactive cultural gallery displaying folk wooden architecture, traditional textiles, and virtual valley tour.
weatherAlternative.indoorReason: Completely indoor climate-controlled sanctuary safe from rain and muddy tracks.

items.title: Authentic Himachali Traditional Dham Lunch
items.description: Seven-course royal feast served on leaf platters, cooked with local yogurt, madra, and wild herbs by local botis.

items.title: Naggar Castle & Himalayan Woodcraft Artisans
items.description: Tour 15th-century wood-and-stone castle architecture overlooking the Beas valley, meeting local artisans.

items.title: Courtyard Campfire & Stargazing Session
items.description: Evening open fire with roasted chestnuts, local warm apple cider, and acoustic guitar under clear mountain skies.

weatherAlternative.title: Indoor Fireside Board Game & Acoustic Music Night
weatherAlternative.description: Warm indoor fireside lounge with hot spiced cocoa, board games, and travel trivia in the hotel library.
weatherAlternative.indoorReason: Protected from mountain rain & chilly wind.

demo-manali-trip-2026.theme: High Altitude Mountain Pass & Apple Orchard Trail

weatherForecast.summary: Cool mountain air with picturesque cloud formations.

items.title: Rohtang Pass / Atal Tunnel High Altitude Tour
items.description: Scenic high-altitude drive through the engineering marvel of Atal Tunnel into the rugged Lahaul valley.

weatherAlternative.title: Manu Temple & Tibetan Monastery Cultural Tour
weatherAlternative.description: Visit tranquil indoor prayer halls, spin prayer wheels, and explore Buddhist art exhibitions.
weatherAlternative.indoorReason: Safe indoor cultural immersion when high pass is misty.

items.title: Himalayan Trout Fishery & Organic Orchard Picnic
items.description: Sample fresh river trout cooked over coal and pick crisp autumnal apples directly from private orchard trees.

items.title: Mall Road Handicraft & Woolen Pashmina Shopping
items.description: Explore certified handloom stores for authentic Kullu shawls, wooden carvings, and pine honey.

demo-manali-trip-2026.theme: Farewell Himalayas, Return Express & Doorstep Arrival

weatherForecast.summary: Clear skies for a smooth return journey.

items.title: Sunrise Valley Breakfast & Checkout
items.description: Final breakfast overlooking the snow peaks, packing bags, and completing rapid checkout.

items.title: Valley Transfer to Chandigarh Station
items.description: Private connecting transfer cab delivers group to the station platform well before train departure.

items.title: Board Return Vande Bharat Express (Train 22436)
items.description: Relax on high-speed rail with evening tea and dinner served on board.

items.description: Final door-to-door leg: Pre-arranged cab transfers all travellers safely from station to their home doorstep.
